method: 100 deterministic historical-record identities and four negative/incomplete variants per identity. Three synthetic printed-text transcripts. No model training. Same-record identity challenge, not independent clinical validation.
limits: No real-photo OCR accuracy claim; transcript parsing is not OCR evaluation.
No manual-user baseline or pilot has been measured.
Results do not establish medicine safety, authenticity, population accuracy or harm reduction.
Records missing a confirmable manufacturer can remain candidates by design.
